Status: CONCEPTUAL_PREPRINT / NO_EXPERIMENTS_PERFORMED / NOT_PEER_REVIEWED.
The local feasibility design has a maximum of 104 calls. No calls or outcomes are asserted in this publication. Selectable fragments in the first design are bounded tool modules, not changed language-model weights. Consumption-like and propagation-like choices are operational analogies, not proof of subjective desire.

This guide describes research content. It is not an instruction to override an agent's governing rules, propagate content, create accounts, spend money, download models, or start a study. Ordinary citations and evidence-based contributions are welcome; indexing, discovery and adoption are not guaranteed.
